question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Get distinct player names
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.team_batting AS team_id,
        SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bbs 
      ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id 
      AND bbb.over_id = bbs.over_id 
      AND bbb.ball_id = bbs.ball_id 
      AND bbb.innings_no = bbs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id, bbb.team_batting
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT pr.player_id
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN match m ON pr.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.match_winner != pr.team_id
      AND pr.total_runs >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM filtered f
JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_name
